/* MobEcodMapper.selectOrderDetail : Order 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.CD_TYPE ,(SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = od.CD_TYPE AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' ) AS CD_TYPE_NM ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.VWT ,od.HSN ,od.AR_DATE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.OB_DATE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,(SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = od.CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_PAYMENT_GUBN' ) AS CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE
,od.DELIVERY_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code = od.DELIVERY_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE') AS DELIVERY_NAME ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code = od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_PAYMENT_GUBN') AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,od.DELIVERY_NOTE ,(SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' ) AS HOLD_NM ,CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N'), '') IN ('', '4') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_REASON FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') ELSE (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' AND CODE = (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N')) END AS HOLD_REASON ,det.NAME_${userLanguage} AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NM ,od.BOUND ,odAdd.CLEARANCE_YN ,odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE ,CASE WHEN pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM290' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CARRYOUT_YN ,CASE WHEN odAdd.CARRYOUT_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CARRYDATE_YN ,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HOLD_YN ,od.DELIVERY_FEE ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(STOCK_DATE_TIME,'') != '' THEN '재고 | ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), STOCK_DATE_TIME, 23) +' | ' + (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = odAdd.STOCK_USER_ID) WHEN ISNULL(CARRYOUT_DATE,'') != '' THEN '반출(세관) | ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), CARRYOUT_DATE, 23) WHEN ISNULL(CARRYIN_DATE,'') != '' THEN '반입(세관) | ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), CARRYIN_DATE, 23) ELSE '' END AS WH_LOCATION_NM ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,CASE WHEN od.INSPECTION_YN = 'Y' THEN '검사' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_YN = 'Y' THEN '선별' WHEN odAdd.XRAY_YN = 'Y' THEN 'X-RAY' END AS INSPECTION_NM ,(SELECT SUM(AR_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST cost WHERE cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'WHC') AS WAREHOUSE_FEE ,odAdd.CLEARANCE_DATE ,odAdd.DROP_YN ,od.MULTI_YN ,CASE WHEN (odAdd.CLEARANCE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_YN ,(SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN POD_STATUS = 'ECM280' THEN '승인' WHEN POD_STATUS = 'ECM290' THEN '반출' END FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS IN('ECM280', 'ECM290')) AS POD_STATUS ,odAdd.INSPECTION_SEQ_NO
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_POD_03 pod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM290' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo})) AND od.DEST_CODE = #{destCode} /*AND od.AR_DATE > DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE())*/ ORDER BY od.PO_DATE DESC, AR_DATE DESC
/* MobEcodMapper.selectCarryoutCnt : Order 출고건수 */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL WHERE CARRYOUT_DATE = CONVERT(CHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) AND CARRYOUT_STATUS = 'F'

/* MobEcodMapper.selectInventoryList : 로케이션 재고 조회 */
SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO, od.MBL_NO, MAX(od.HBL_NO) AS HBL_NO, SUM(od.PIECES) AS PIECES, CASE WHEN odAdd.CARRYOUT_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CARRYOUT_YN, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HOLD_YN, MAX(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC, od.CONSIGNEE_NAME)) AS CONSIGNEE_NAME, MAX(od.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE, MAX(od.INSPECTION_YN) AS INSPECTION_YN FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND odAdd.WH_LOCATION = #{whLocation} AND DEST_CODE = #{destCode} AND odAdd.WH_CARRYOUT_DATE IS NOT NULL AND odAdd.CARRYOUT_USER_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY od.OD_JOB_NO, od.MBL_NO, odAdd.CARRYOUT_DATE

/* MobEcodMapper.selectOrderMulti : Multi 멀티중량 List */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY SEQ_NO_ID ASC) AS NUM ,multi.OD_JOB_NO ,multi.SEQ_NO_ID ,multi.DELIVERY_NO ,multi.DELIVERY_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE' AND CODE = multi.DELIVERY_CODE) AS DELIVERY_NAME ,multi.CUSTOMER_CODE ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND CUSTOMER_CODE = multi.CUSTOMER_CODE) AS CUSTOMER_NAME ,multi.DELIVERY_NO_CHANGED ,multi.PIECES ,multi.PAYMENT_GUBN ,multi.DELIVERY_FEE ,multi.DIM_WIDTH ,multi.DIM_LENGTH ,multi.DIM_HEIGHT ,multi.VWT FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI multi WHERE multi.OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ORDER BY multi.SEQ_NO_ID
mapper.update: /* MobEcodMapper.multiBatchSave : 멀티등록 일괄등록 */ INSERT INTO TB_ECM_OD_MULTI( OD_JOB_NO ,SEQ_NO_ID ,DELIVERY_NO ,DELIVERY_CODE ,PIECES ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,RECIPIENT_NAME ,RECEIPT_DATE ) SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO) ,od.HBL_NO ,#{deliveryCode} ,od.PIECES ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,#{recipientName} ,#{gmtTime} FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})

/* MobEcodMapper.saveReceiptList : 멀티 인계 또는 취소처리*/ UPDATE TB_ECM_OD_MULTI SET
DELIVERER_USER_ID = #{recipientUserId} ,DELIVERY_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) ,RECIPIENT_NAME = #{recipientName} ,RECEIPT_DATE = DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE())
DELIVERER_USER_ID = NULL ,DELIVERY_DATE = NULL ,RECIPIENT_NAME = NULL ,RECEIPT_DATE = NULL
WHERE OD_JOB_NO IN (#{item.odJobNo})
mapper.select: /* MobEcodMapper.selectMultiOrderDetail : 화물 일괄 조회(하우스번호) */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,(CASE WHEN 'ECM280' IN (SELECT POD_STATUS FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 po WHERE od.ENT_CODE = po.ENT_CODE AND od.OD_JOB_NO = po.OD_JOB_NO) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS ECM280YN ,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HOLD_YN ,STUFF((SELECT CONCAT('|', SEQ_NO_ID) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND DELIVERY_NO = od.HBL_NO FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') as SEQ_NO_ID FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo})) AND od.AR_DATE > DATEADD(DD, -90, GETDATE()) AND od.DEST_CODE = #{destCode}
mapper.update: /* MobEcodMapper.insertMultiOrderDelivery : 변경배송사 신규등록 */ INSERT INTO TB_ECM_OD_MULTI( OD_JOB_NO ,SEQ_NO_ID ,DELIVERY_NO ,DELIVERY_CODE ,PAYMENT_GUBN ,DELIVERY_FEE ,PIECES ,DIM_WIDTH ,DIM_LENGTH ,DIM_HEIGHT ,VWT ,REGISTER_USER_ID ,REGISTER_DATE_TIME )VALUES( #{odJobNo} ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(SEQ_NO_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}) ,LTRIM(RTRIM(REPLACE(#{hblNo},char(9),''))) ,#{deliveryCode} ,'01' ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,#{registerUserId} ,DATEADD(HOUR, ${gmtTime}, GETDATE()) )
mapper.select: /* MobEcodMapper.selectCaseOrderDetail : 화물 건별 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.PO_DATE ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.DELIVERY_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code = od.DELIVERY_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE') AS DELIVERY_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD od WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo})) AND od.DEST_CODE = #{destCode}

/* MobEcodMapper.selectCaseOrderDetailMultiVe : 화물 건별 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.BOUND ,mul.PAYMENT_GUBN AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,od.PO_DATE ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,od.DELIVERY_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code = od.DELIVERY_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE') AS DELIVERY_NAME FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mul LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD od ON od.OD_JOB_NO = mul.OD_JOB_NO WHERE DELIVERY_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo})) AND od.DEST_CODE = #{destCode} AND od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode}

/* MobEcodMapper.selectOrderDetail : Order 조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.MBL_NO ,od.HBL_NO ,od.CD_TYPE ,(SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = od.CD_TYPE AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'CD_TYPE' ) AS CD_TYPE_NM ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,od.VWT ,od.HSN ,od.AR_DATE ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.OB_DATE ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.COMMODITY_ITEM ,(SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_CUSTOMER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND CUSTOMER_CODE = od.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,od.SHIPPER_NAME ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,od.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,od.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,(SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = od.CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_PAYMENT_GUBN' ) AS CLEARANCE_PAYMENT_TYPE
,od.DELIVERY_CODE ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code = od.DELIVERY_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_DELIVERY_CODE') AS DELIVERY_NAME ,(SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND code = od.DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE AND GROUP_CODE = 'ECM_PAYMENT_GUBN') AS DELIVERY_PAYMENT_TYPE ,od.DELIVERY_NOTE ,(SELECT ISNULL(sta.NAME_${userLanguage}, sta.NAME_DEFAULT) FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL sta WHERE sta.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND sta.CODE = (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') AND sta.GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' ) AS HOLD_NM ,CASE WHEN ISNULL((SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N'), '') IN ('', '4') THEN (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_REASON FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') ELSE (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'HOLD_CODE' AND CODE = (SELECT TOP 1 HOLD_CODE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N')) END AS HOLD_REASON ,det.NAME_${userLanguage} AS LAST_POD_STATUS_NM ,od.BOUND ,odAdd.CLEARANCE_YN ,odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE ,CASE WHEN pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM290' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CARRYOUT_YN ,CASE WHEN odAdd.CARRYOUT_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS CARRYDATE_YN ,CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND HOLD_RELEASE_YN = 'N') > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS HOLD_YN ,od.DELIVERY_FEE ,CASE WHEN ISNULL(STOCK_DATE_TIME,'') != '' THEN '재고 | ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), STOCK_DATE_TIME, 23) +' | ' + (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = odAdd.STOCK_USER_ID) WHEN ISNULL(CARRYOUT_DATE,'') != '' THEN '반출(세관) | ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), CARRYOUT_DATE, 23) WHEN ISNULL(CARRYIN_DATE,'') != '' THEN '반입(세관) | ' + CONVERT(CHAR(10), CARRYIN_DATE, 23) ELSE '' END AS WH_LOCATION_NM ,od.INSPECTION_YN ,odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_YN ,CASE WHEN od.INSPECTION_YN = 'Y' THEN '검사' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_YN = 'Y' THEN '선별' WHEN odAdd.XRAY_YN = 'Y' THEN 'X-RAY' END AS INSPECTION_NM ,(SELECT SUM(AR_AMOUNT) FROM TB_ECM_OD_COST cost WHERE cost.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND CHARGE_CODE = 'WHC') AS WAREHOUSE_FEE ,odAdd.CLEARANCE_DATE ,odAdd.DROP_YN ,CASE WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '01' THEN '총기' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '02' THEN '마약' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '03' THEN '검역' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '04' THEN '식품' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '05' THEN '의약품' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '06' THEN '수입검사' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = 'C' THEN '수입검사' WHEN odAdd.SE_INSPECTION_CODE = '07' THEN 'AI고위험' ELSE '검사미지정' END AS SE_INSPECTION_CHK ,(CAST(odAdd.INSPECTION_SEQ_NO AS VARCHAR) + '/' + CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_OD AS AB WHERE AB.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO) AS VARCHAR)) AS INSPECTION_SEQ_DISPLAY ,od.MULTI_YN ,CASE WHEN (odAdd.CLEARANCE_DATE IS NOT NULL AND odAdd.CARRYIN_DATE IS NOT NULL ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS USE_YN ,(SELECT TOP 1 CASE WHEN POD_STATUS = 'ECM280' THEN '승인' WHEN POD_STATUS = 'ECM290' THEN '반출' END FROM TB_ECM_POD_03 WHERE OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND POD_STATUS IN('ECM280', 'ECM290')) AS POD_STATUS ,odAdd.INSPECTION_SEQ_NO
,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_HP_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_HP ,dbo.Cryptography(od.OD_JOB_NO, od.CONSIGNEE_TEL_ENC, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL
,od.CONSIGNEE_HP ,od.CONSIGNEE_TEL
FROM TB_ECM_OD od LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL odAdd ON od.OD_JOB_NO = odAdd.OD_JOB_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ECM_POD_03 pod ON od.OD_JOB_NO = pod.OD_JOB_NO AND pod.POD_STATUS = 'ECM290' LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL det ON od.ENT_CODE = det.ENT_CODE AND det.GROUP_CODE = 'STATUS_ORDER_CARGO' AND odAdd.LAST_POD_STATUS = det.CODE WHERE od.ENT_CODE = #{entCode} AND od.HBL_NO = LTRIM(RTRIM(#{hblNo})) AND od.DEST_CODE = #{destCode} /*AND od.AR_DATE > DATEADD(day, -90, GETDATE())*/ ORDER BY od.PO_DATE DESC, AR_DATE DESC
